name: skill-bench-runner
description: LLM router benchmark runner for skill-bench.md

scripts.mock: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode echo --provider mock --model mock
scripts.mock:recall: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode recall --provider mock --model mock
scripts.bench:openai:echo: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode echo --provider openai --model gpt-4o --key $OPENAI_API_KEY
scripts.bench:openai:recall: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode recall --provider openai --model gpt-4o --key $OPENAI_API_KEY
scripts.bench:anthropic:echo: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode echo --provider anthropic --model claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 --key $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
scripts.bench:anthropic:recall: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode recall --provider anthropic --model claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 --key $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
scripts.bench:gemini:echo: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode echo --provider gemini --model gemini-2.0-flash --key $GEMINI_API_KEY
scripts.bench:gemini:recall: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode recall --provider gemini --model gemini-2.0-flash --key $GEMINI_API_KEY
scripts.bench:deepseek:echo: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode echo --provider deepseek --model deepseek-reasoner --key $DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
scripts.bench:groq:echo: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode echo --provider groq --model llama-3.1-8b-instant --key $GROQ_API_KEY --delay 2000
scripts.bench:groq:recall: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode recall --provider groq --model llama-3.1-8b-instant --key $GROQ_API_KEY --delay 2000
scripts.bench:groq:70b:echo: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode echo --provider groq --model llama-3.3-70b-versatile --key $GROQ_API_KEY --delay 2000
scripts.bench:groq:70b:recall: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode recall --provider groq --model llama-3.3-70b-versatile --key $GROQ_API_KEY --delay 2000
scripts.bench:cerebras:echo: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode echo --provider cerebras --model llama3.1-8b --key $CEREBRAS_API_KEY --delay 2000
scripts.bench:cerebras:recall: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode recall --provider cerebras --model llama3.1-8b --key $CEREBRAS_API_KEY --delay 2000
scripts.bench:cerebras:70b:echo: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode echo --provider cerebras --model llama3.3-70b --key $CEREBRAS_API_KEY --delay 2000
scripts.smoke: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode echo --provider mock --model mock --limit 10
scripts.smoke:recall: tsx run.ts --suite routing-flat --mode recall --provider mock --model mock --limit 10
